text:
Silas: Following up on the all-hands reorg section 11 — open thread for any hiring/org questions. Keep them short and we'll answer.

Maya: Quick summary: no mass layoffs. We're shifting ~10 roles from infra projects into product-facing squads and planning ~4 net new hires this quarter to cover ML infra and SLA work.

Ravi: Is that a hard freeze on external hiring?

Maya: Not a full freeze. Non-critical external reqs are paused while we run internal transfers. Critical customer-impact roles still go through and will be prioritized.

Leah: People Ops: internal transfer window opens Thursday 9am PT for 10 business days. Managers will get impacted lists tomorrow.

Dana: If someone declines a transfer, what happens?

Leah: Opt-outs allowed. We'll help with alternative placements or a phased transition. No one will be forced.

Chris: Finance check: we can convert up to 5 contractors to FTEs and budget the 4 hires this FY under the reorg bucket.

Ravi: Any changes to reporting lines? My squad heard they might report to a different director.

Maya: A few squads will move from Platform into Product Delivery for tighter alignment. No wholesale manager shakeup; detailed org charts out next week.

people-ops-bot: :information_source: Reminder: submit internal applications via Careers Portal. Templates + FAQs will be uploaded to the HR drive by EOD.

Silas: Promotion cycles / comp bands affected?

Maya: No change to promotion cadence or bands. Any exceptions will be documented case-by-case.

Dana: Do managers need to rewrite job descriptions?

Leah: People Ops will provide templates. Hiring managers should review and add role-specific bullets. We'll fast-track transfer interviews.

Ravi: Will APAC hiring be impacted?

Leah: NA/EMEA hires proceed; APAC is opportunistic unless a priority is approved. Flag candidate leads to me.

Silas: Poll opened by bot: "Do you feel you understand the reorg impact on your team?" (24h).

Maya: We'll keep this thread live until Friday and publish an FAQ + timeline. DM @Leah or @Maya for private chats. Thanks everyone.
